title: Harry Potter: Battle for Hogwarts
shortDescription: Hogwarts houses, memorable spells, magical creatures, and Harry Potter trivia at WesCo.
description: Calling all witches, wizards, and trivia-loving Muggles. Gather your team at WesCo Brew & Bowl for Harry Potter: Battle for Hogwarts, with questions about Hogwarts houses, spells, familiar characters, magical creatures, and memorable moments from the wizarding world. How much does your team really know?
instructions: Contact the venue for seating or participation details. Food and drinks are purchased separately.
